tables.name: evidence_graph_nodes
tables.purpose: Registry of every manifest, validator, generated artifact

tables.name: evidence_graph_edges
tables.purpose: Relationships between evidence nodes (validated_by, depends_on, etc.)

tables.name: cron_run_receipts
tables.purpose: Proof that scheduled jobs (verifiers, drills, sweeps) actually fired

tables.name: release_decisions
tables.purpose: Append-only record of every gate outcome from the master release aggregator

tables.name: installed_apps_receipts
tables.purpose: Owner-scoped proof of every install/uninstall/update in the App Platform

tables.name: advisor_action_proof_packs
tables.purpose: Reversibility evidence + rollback tokens for every advisor-executed action

tables.name: kill_switch_ttl_expiry_receipts
tables.purpose: Append-only proof that kill-switch auto-expiry actually ran

edgeFunctions.name: cron-receipt-collector
edgeFunctions.purpose: Persists cron job heartbeats into cron_run_receipts

edgeFunctions.name: app-manifest-verifier
edgeFunctions.purpose: Verifies app manifest signatures, writes installed_apps_receipts

notes: All 7 tables have RLS enabled. Append-only tables enforce via triggers.
Node count starts at 0 — populated by first evidence-graph-builder invocation.
Validators run in WARN mode during 14-day burn-in, then promote to BLOCK.
